Name: (Currently Broken for 1.6) Upgradeable Machines Mod
Author: Miihau
Description:
[center][size=6][b][u][color=#ff0000][size=5]For 1.6 alternative:[/size][/color][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720][color=#e69138]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720[/color][/url]



[color=#93c47d]Upgradeable Machines[/color][u] - Process Your Goods Faster![/u]
[/b][/size][/center][size=4][center]Upgrade your favorite processing machines in Stardew Valley and supercharge your productivity with the Upgradeable Machines mod! Say goodbye to long processing times and hello to efficient production. With this mod, you can now transform your ordinary Preserves Jars, Kegs, Furnaces, and Crystalariums into powerful, time-saving devices.[/center][/size]
[center]-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]https://iili.io/HiuLvP2.jpg[/img]﻿
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center][size=4][b]
Disclaimer: upgraded Furnaces and Crystalariums currently have no custom ore and custom gem support. (I planning on adding support in the next version) Kegs and Preserves Jars work with custom crops, roe etc. (Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1177914]akbaroth[/url] for testing 🧡)

How Does it work:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]There are 2 levels of upgrades for select machines after the "Normal" version of the machine: "Better" and "Best"﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]Obtain the corresponding Upgrade Kits from Robin's (Preserves Jar and Keg) or Clint's shops (Furnace and Crystalarium)[SPOILER][img]https://iili.io/HiuDXf4.gif[/img]﻿[img]https://iili.io/HiuDh0l.gif[/img]﻿[/size][/SPOILER]
[*][size=4]To upgrade pick up a "Kit" in your inventory and right-click with the lesser level machine in your inventory. Example:[SPOILER][img]https://iili.io/Hiupkbt.gif[/img]﻿[/SPOILER][/size]
[*][size=4]Each upgrade level cuts the processing time in half. Example: [SPOILER][img]https://iili.io/HiuLgS9.gif[/img]﻿[/SPOILER][/size]
[*][size=4]Enjoy faster and more productive gameplay[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[center]-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[b]How to install:[/b]
[list]
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ installed
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿ installed
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2516]Custom Crystalarium Mod[/url]﻿ installed
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JsonAssets[/url]﻿ installed
[*][list]
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6529]Expanded Preconditions Utility[/url]﻿ installed
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿ installed
[/list]
[*]Now you can Paste the "MiihausUpgradeableMachiens(packape)" folder in your Mod Folder
[/list][/size]

Downloads.Description:
To change just remove the '[JA]UpgradeableMachines' folder from the 'MiihausUpgradeableMachines(packge)' folder
and paste the '[JA]UpgradeableMachines(easier recipes)' folder in the 'MiihausUpgradeableMachines(packge)' folder

To change just remove the '[JA]UpgradeableMachines' folder from the 'MiihausUpgradeableMachines(packge)' folder
and paste the '[JA]UpgradeableMachines(harder recipes)' folder in the 'MiihausUpgradeableMachines(packge)' folder

PLEASE READ THE DESCRIPTION ON THE MOD PAGE
It explains how it work :)

(Some people reported to get a warning that the file may be dangerous. I don't know why this is happening. My mod has been verified to be safe to use and has no malicious data)
